description: Quote a Polymarket order before you place it: resolves the market and outcome token, walks the live order book for the expected fill (shares, average and worst price, slippage vs best and mid) and shows the platform fee and total cost. Read-only: places no order. Accepts a market slug, id, polymarket.com URL or a prediction_market_arbitrage id (polymarket:<id>). Polymarket is close-only or blocked in the US and many other regions. Costs $0.005 USDC per call.

amountUsd.description: For a buy: USD to spend

limitPrice.description: Optional limit price between 0 and 1 (a multiple of the market's tick size)

market.description: Market slug, Gamma id, polymarket.com URL, or 'polymarket:<id>'

shares.description: For a sell: shares to sell
